description: Korean safety and health staffing duty (산업안전보건법 시행령 별표 2·3·5, 제24조): safety and health manager-in-chief (50/100/300 workers by industry, construction 2B KRW+), safety officers (manufacturing/transport 50-499 → 1, 500+ → 2; retail/food & lodging 50-999 → 1; construction by contract amount from 5B KRW), health officers (by industry from 50 workers; construction 80B KRW, civil 100B, or 600 workers), safety-health staff for 20-49 worker manufacturing etc., full-time requirement at 300 workers (construction 12B/civil 15B), and the risk assessment cycle (시행규칙 제37조, 고시 제2026-73호). Representative industries only; check the annex for others.
